title: Fix TypeScript Definition ID Doc Formatting
description: Fix semio-repo TypeScript definition ID formatting so generated doc comments do not emit an extra blank `*` line before the ID link and do not render a doubled `* *` marker. Verify the generation path affecting shared.ts outputs and update existing code accordingly.
summary: Fixed the TypeScript native-docstring autofix so definition identification lines are emitted as a single JSDoc line without an extra blank separator or doubled asterisk marker. Repaired an existing malformed test wrapper in main_test.go and extended the existing autofix test to lock down the identification-line formatting. Verified with targeted Go tests covering the formatter and surrounding autofix paths.
